title: Material Design of Porous Hydroxyapatite Ceramics via Inverse Analysis of an Estimation Model for Bone-Forming Ability Based on Machine Learning and Experimental Validation of Biological Hard Tissue Responses.
summary: Full MDPI text reviewed in Chrome: two machine-learning models estimate bioceramic properties from fabrication settings and bone-formation rate from material properties/in-vivo conditions. Inverse design candidates were fabricated, and a 12-week porcine-tibia implantation comparison found measured bone-formation rates within the model error range. Approve as a machine-learning-guided biomaterials result with limited sample/data and animal-model scope.
ai_technology: GMR Models 1 and 2 learn fabrication-to-material-property and material/in-vivo-condition-to-bone-formation mappings; inverse analysis proposes target-specific material conditions.
